config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%hiv test%' OR name LIKE '%hiv test%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0

rowFilter.name: Base Cohort for HCT TST Facility 2019 Patient List

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%hiv test%' OR name LIKE '%hiv test%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0

SELECT pi.identifier FROM patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = :patientId AND pi.identifier_type = (SELECT patient_identifier_type_id FROM patient_identifier_type WHERE uuid = '7faf6b56-08a4-4c06-bc31-3a12f17bd05b') AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.date_created DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CONCAT(given_name, ' ', family_name) FROM person_name WHERE person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY preferred DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT gender FROM person WHERE person_id = :patientId
SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birthdate, :endDate) FROM person WHERE person_id = :patientId

SELECT value FROM person_attribute WHERE person_id = :patientId AND person_attribute_type_id = (SELECT person_attribute_type_id FROM person_attribute_type WHERE uuid = 'a640f592-7c09-4b4e-b0e0-1f53b0354aba') AND voided = 0

SELECT o.obs_datetime FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%hiv test%' OR name LIKE '%hiv test%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT cn.name FROM obs o INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON o.value_coded = cn.concept_id WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%hiv test%' OR name LIKE '%hiv test%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 AND cn.voided = 0 AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT cn.name FROM obs o INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON o.value_coded = cn.concept_id WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%testing modality%' OR name LIKE '%testing modality%' OR uuid LIKE '%test type%' OR name LIKE '%test type%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 AND cn.voided = 0 AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%tb screen%' OR name LIKE '%tb screen%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

SELECT cn.name FROM obs o INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON o.value_coded = cn.concept_id WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%tb screen%' OR name LIKE '%tb screen%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 AND cn.voided = 0 AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT cn.name FROM obs o INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON o.value_coded = cn.concept_id WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%partner present%' OR name LIKE '%partner present%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 AND cn.voided = 0 AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%partner test%' OR name LIKE '%partner test%') AND o.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%yes%' OR name LIKE '%yes%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

SELECT cn.name FROM obs o INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON o.value_coded = cn.concept_id WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%partner result%' OR name LIKE '%partner result%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 AND cn.voided = 0 AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%art referral%' OR name LIKE '%art referral%') AND o.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%yes%' OR name LIKE '%yes%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

SELECT pp.date_enrolled FROM patient_program pp INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id WHERE p.uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d' AND pp.patient_id = :patientId AND pp.date_enrolled >= :startDate AND pp.date_enrolled <= :endDate AND (pp.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND pp.voided = 0 ORDER BY pp.date_enrolled ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_program pp WHERE pp.patient_id = :patientId AND pp.program_id = (SELECT program_id FROM program WHERE uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d') AND pp.date_enrolled >= (SELECT o.obs_datetime FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%hiv test%' OR name LIKE '%hiv test%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1) AND pp.date_enrolled <= DATE_ADD((SELECT o.obs_datetime FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%hiv test%' OR name LIKE '%hiv test%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND pp.voided = 0) THEN 'Linked' ELSE 'Not Linked' END

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%index client%' OR name LIKE '%index client%') AND o.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%yes%' OR name LIKE '%yes%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

SELECT COALESCE(CAST(o.value_numeric AS SIGNED), 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%family tested%' OR name LIKE '%family tested%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM person_address WHERE person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY date_created DESC LIMIT 1
